# Regression test for the if-multi-child variable collision.
#
# When an `if` body contains more than one statement under a single parent
# slot, every child rendered into the *same* `<innerVar>` and prior children
# would be clobbered. Worse, any child that itself emitted
# `<innerVar>Children` (every container does) collided with its sibling and
# the generated Go failed to compile with "redeclared in this block".

# Post-Plan-C the window body flows through WalkLowered and the
# declarative lowering pass emits AppendChild for every NodeInst
# declared inside conditional/loop bodies, threaded back to the
# surrounding parent. Verify each `text(...)` widget inside the `if`
# is constructed AND added to the surrounding vbox.

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --opt=main=true --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# The vbox is __n3; the three text children are __n0..__n2 (allocated in pass-1).
# The labels do not escape __renderSlot0 (created, added, and tracked in
# m.__slot0 all within that scope), so the node-escape lower pass emits them
# as distinct function-local variables — which also rules out the original
# variable collision this test guards against.
grep '__n0 := widget\.NewLabel' out/model.go
grep '__n1 := widget\.NewLabel' out/model.go
grep '__n2 := widget\.NewLabel' out/model.go

# Each label inside the if-body is appended to the parent via __renderSlot0.
grep 'container\.Add\(__n0\)' out/model.go
grep 'container\.Add\(__n1\)' out/model.go
grep 'container\.Add\(__n2\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { go { fyne } }

component main {
    var visible = true

    window #app(title="t") {
        vbox {
            if visible {
                text(value="A")
                text(value="B")
                text(value="C")
            }
        }
    }
}
